Pre-conditions:

2. For each register, check skip_rst_array[i]; if 1, skip the register
3. Check read_mask_array[i]; if 0x00000000, skip (register not readable)
4. Call read_reg(addr_array[i]) to read the register value
5. Mask the read value with 0xFFFFFFFE (clear bit 0)
6. Compare masked read value against default_value_array[i]
7. If mismatch, increment def_fail_cnt and log error with address, expected, and actual values

Description: Test level-triggered interrupt generation with level_sel=1 (active high) for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 through GPIO_39). For each pin: configure input mode with level interrupt enabled and level_sel=1, enable group interrupt, trigger interrupt via SRAM write, verify interrupt in ISR by checking per-pin raw status and group status, clear interrupt, verify clear, and clear sysreg status.
Pre-conditions:
1. System reset completed
2. GIC initialized and IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or IRQ 88 (GPIO1) enabled
3. SRAM at 0xA0243ffc accessible for interrupt triggering
4. Sysreg interrupt enabled (MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 written)
Test Steps:
For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31, representing GPIO_8 to GPIO_39):
1. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4), 0x00180000) — Set input mode (io_ctrl=1, bit20) and level_sel=1 (bit19), enabling level interrupt on high
2. wait_on(50)
3. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 1<<i) — Enable group interrupt for this pin
4. wait_on(10)
5. write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF) — Write to SRAM to trigger interrupt
6. Set int_pend=1; wait in polling loop until ISR clears int_pend
7. IN ISR (Default_IRQHandler):
   a. write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF)
   b. read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4)) — Check intr_raw_sts (bit 1)
   c. Verify (rdata & 0x2) != 0 (raw interrupt raised)
   d. read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1) — Check group interrupt status bit i
   e. Verify (rdata_grp & (1<<i)) != 0
   f. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4), 0x00110000) — Clear interrupt (intr_clr=1, bit16)
   g. wait_on(20)
   h. read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4)) — Verify cleared (expect 0x100001)
   i. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0x00000000) — Disable group interrupt
   j. read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1) — Verify group status cleared (expect 0x0)
   k. write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, sysreg_clear_value) — Clear sysreg status
   l. read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1) — Verify sysreg cleared
   m. GIC_ClearIRQ(87/88)
Expected Results:
1. For each of 32 GPIO pins:
   a. Per-pin intr_raw_sts (bit 1) is set when level=high detected → (rdata & 0x2) != 0
   b. Group interrupt status bit is set → (rdata_grp & (1<<i)) != 0
   c. After interrupt clear: register reads 0x100001 (io_ctrl=1 in bit20, data_in=1 in bit0)
   d. After disabling group interrupt: gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 == 0x0
   e. Sysreg status cleared successfully
2. test_err == 0 at end of all 32 pins
Registers Accessed: gp0_gpio_8 to gp0_gpio_39 (0x00-0x7C), gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (0x84), gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 (0x88), MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 (external), MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 (external), 0xA0243ffc (SRAM)
Register Fields Exercised: Per-GPIO: data_in[0](RO), intr_raw_sts[1](RO), intr_clr[16](WO), level_sel[19](RW), io_ctrl[20](RW2); gp0_intr1_intr_en1: G8-G39_intr_en[0-31](RW); gp0_intr1_intr_sts1: G8-G39_intr_sts[0-31](RO)
Access Types: Write (GPIO config, intr_en, SRAM, intr_clr, sysreg_clr), Read (GPIO status, group_sts, sysreg_sts)
Notes: Active-high level: 0x00180000 = bit19(level_sel=1) + bit20(io_ctrl=1/input mode). Interrupt is level-triggered: stays asserted as long as pin level matches level_sel. MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 and MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 are external to GPIO register block (LSS SYSREG). 0xA0243ffc is SRAM used for interrupt triggering mechanism.

Description: Test level-triggered interrupt generation with level_sel=0 (active low) for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 through GPIO_39). For each pin: configure input mode with level interrupt enabled and level_sel=0, enable group interrupt, trigger interrupt via SRAM write with inverted pin mask, verify interrupt in ISR, clear interrupt, verify clear, and clear sysreg status.
Pre-conditions:
1. System reset completed
2. GIC initialized and IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or IRQ 88 (GPIO1) enabled
3. Active-high level interrupt test (TC_003) completed
4. SRAM at 0xA0243ffc accessible
5. Sysreg interrupt enabled
Test Steps:
For each GPIO pin i (0 to 31, representing GPIO_8 to GPIO_39):
1. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4), 0x00100000) — Set input mode (io_ctrl=1, bit20) with level_sel=0 (bit19=0), enabling level interrupt on low
2. wait_on(50)
3. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 1<<i) — Enable group interrupt for this pin
4. wait_on(10)
5. write_reg(0xA0243ffc, ~(1<<i)) — Write inverted mask to SRAM to trigger low-level interrupt
6. Set int_pend=1; wait in polling loop until ISR clears int_pend
7. IN ISR (Default_IRQHandler): Same sequence as TC_003 steps 7a-7m
Expected Results:
1. For each of 32 GPIO pins:
   a. Per-pin intr_raw_sts (bit 1) is set when level=low detected → (rdata & 0x2) != 0
   b. Group interrupt status bit is set → (rdata_grp & (1<<i)) != 0
   c. After interrupt clear: register reads 0x100001
   d. After disabling group interrupt: gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 == 0x0
   e. Sysreg status cleared successfully
2. test_err == 0 at end of all 32 pins
Registers Accessed: gp0_gpio_8 to gp0_gpio_39 (0x00-0x7C), gp0_intr1_intr_en1 (0x84), gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 (0x88), MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 (external), MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 (external), 0xA0243ffc (SRAM)
Register Fields Exercised: Per-GPIO: data_in[0](RO), intr_raw_sts[1](RO), intr_clr[16](WO), level_sel[19](RW), io_ctrl[20](RW2); gp0_intr1_intr_en1: G8-G39_intr_en[0-31](RW); gp0_intr1_intr_sts1: G8-G39_intr_sts[0-31](RO)
Access Types: Write (GPIO config, intr_en, SRAM, intr_clr, sysreg_clr), Read (GPIO status, group_sts, sysreg_sts)
Notes: Active-low level: 0x00100000 = bit20(io_ctrl=1/input mode) only, bit19(level_sel)=0. SRAM write uses ~(1<<i) to drive the specific pin low while others remain high. ISR handling is identical to TC_003. MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 and MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 are external to GPIO register block. 0xA0243ffc is SRAM used for interrupt triggering mechanism.
